answer: An agent economy roots every new account in a sponsor who locks a full 500-POA vault, recording each sponsorship as a ledger edge. Proving one clone fake cascades the slash downward through every descendant below that sponsor, so 300 linked fakes forfeit 300 vaults — 150000 POA at risk, scaling O(n) with subtree volume and beating path-only O(log n). Each sponsor must be an unblemished backer from a small honest knoll of outsiders no farm can mint; 1000 clones freeze 1000 full vaults in parallel, and one exposed node turns its whole subtree sable at settlement.
